context: A police officer briefs a reporter about port security
purpose: Teach: 女王/外来/航海/南米/無名/無数/メタ/語彙

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 港湾警備、外来船舶のチェック、強化中です。
lines.en: Port security is focused on strengthening checks of foreign vessels.
lines.style: Measured, official opening. Even pace, clear diction. Professional but not stiff—a man used to brief, accurate statements. Eye contact level.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 南米から、女王時代の航海図を悪用し、無名の小型船で密入国が試みられた事例もありましたね。
lines.en: There have even been cases from South America—smuggling attempts in unmarked small boats, exploiting old colonial-era navigation charts.
lines.style: Thoughtful, specific curiosity. Slight lean forward on the question. He's showing he's done his homework. Warm intellectual engagement, not challenging.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: はい。無数の航海ルート、データ化しています。
lines.en: Yes. We're digitizing countless voyage routes into our database.
lines.style: Steady and factual. Short, confident phrases. No flourish—just the work being done. Slight nod of acknowledgment at the question.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: メタ分析で、傾向を予測する手法、活用されてますか。
lines.en: Are meta-analytic methods being used to forecast patterns?
lines.style: Genuine technical inquiry, not performative. Quiet intensity. He's asking because he wants to know. Slight pause before 'meta-analytic' to show he's choosing his words carefully.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: はい。専門語彙、警察学校でも教えられます。
lines.en: Yes. That specialized vocabulary is part of the curriculum at the police academy.
lines.style: Confirmatory and brief, closing the thought. Calm authority. Delivers the practical detail plainly. Slight settling-back in posture—he's satisfied the question warrants a real answer.
